definitions.gloss: playboy; idler; someone who lives for pleasure
definitions.explanation: A person who does no steady work and spends their time and money on pleasure, such as drinking, gambling or romance. Also used of someone who has many casual lovers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{遊|あそ}び{人|にん}だ。
{遊|あそ}び{人|にん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遊|あそ}び{人|にん}だった⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧まじめになった。
examples.english: My father was a pleasure-seeker in his youth, but now he has become completely serious.

notes:
Disapproving, though it can be said half-admiringly. Mostly of men.
